panels.title: Dead-letter topic offset
panels.description: kafka_topic_partition_current_offset for game.events.dlq, timeline.events.dlq, and game.commands.dlq. Any increase means a record was parked. Alerts on KafkaDeadLetterTrafficDetected (see observability/vmalert/rules.yml).

panels.title: Dead-letter records parked (5m count)
panels.description: Count of each dead-letter topic's offset increase over a trailing 5-minute window (same increase() semantics as the KafkaDeadLetterTrafficDetected alert rule).
